description: This Java class 'ThingEventPubSubFactory' provides a factory for creating pub-sub mechanisms for 'ThingEvent' objects within an actor-based system. It offers methods to instantiate pub-sub factories based on shard region extraction, read subject extraction, or shard ID only strategies, configuring how 'ThingEvent' messages are published and subscribed in a distributed environment.

classes.name: ThingEventPubSubFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating pub-sub publishers and subscribers for 'ThingEvent' objects, supporting different extraction strategies such as shard-based, read-subject-only, and shard-id-only configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory for thing events based on the provided actor context and shard region extractor.

methods.name: readSubjectsOnly
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory that ignores shard ID topics, focusing only on read subjects.

methods.name: shardIdOnly
methods.description: Creates a pubsub factory that ignores read subjects and focuses on shard ID topics, parameterized by number of shards.

methods.name: readSubjectOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Internal method returning an extractor configured for read subjects with constant topics.

methods.name: shardIdOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Internal method returning an extractor configured for shard ID topics.

methods.name: toTopicExtractor
methods.description: Internal method combining constant topics and shard ID extraction based on the shard region extractor.
